assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness that have persisted despite initial rate control therapy.
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0).
The patient has a history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9).
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is indicated to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances and guide further management.
The service is denied due to missing precertification.
